info.name: Sentinel Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection — all routes go through the API Gateway on port 3000.

Flow:
1. Register or Login → token is auto-saved to {{token}}
2. Use any protected route — Bearer token is added automatically via collection auth
3. Edge routes use {{edgeSecret}} header instead of JWT

item.name: Surveillance Analytics
item.description: Real-time crowd, traffic, and spatial metrics from the 19-module surveillance analytics engine running inside ai-detection. Data is ingested every 30 s per camera and stored in TimescaleDB. All endpoints require Bearer auth via gateway.

request.description: Full latest snapshot per camera with all module outputs: crowd_density, queue_analytics, zone_occupancy, flow_anomaly_index, gathering_statistics, speed_statistics, traffic_density, traffic_throughput, directional_flow, parking_occupancy, crossing_usage, activity_heatmap, dwell_time, movement_patterns, object_distribution, pedestrian_flow, peak_analysis, trend_monitor, hourly_report, scene_baseline. Also returns totals across all cameras.
Most recent raw snapshot per camera: camera_id, timestamp, persons, vehicles, total_alerts, modules (full JSONB).
Time-series of crowd metrics over the last N hours: persons, current_count, rolling_avg, peak_count, capacity_utilization_pct, trend_direction, zone_current (per-zone counts).
Time-series of traffic metrics: vehicles, mean_speed, median_speed, speeding_rate, speed_limit, throughput, traffic_density.
Called internally by ai-detection every 30 s per camera. Can be used to manually inject a snapshot. Returns {"ok": true}.
Send a message to the AI chatbot. Omit session_id to start a new session.
Return full conversation history for a chatbot session.

item.name: AI Detection Service (Direct)
item.description: ai-detection FastAPI service on port 8010 — accessed directly, no auth required. Runs per-camera micro-batch inference (SkelNet, WeaponDetector, SurveillanceAnalytics) and pushes incidents to the backend. Stream and snapshot endpoints serve annotated MJPEG/JPEG frames with detection overlays.

request.description: Returns {"status": "ok", "service": "ai-detection"}.
503 while models are loading, 200 once ready. Returns: status, detectors (active model names), load_times (seconds per model).
Returns all active camera pipelines: camera_id, status, fps, active_detectors, last_fusion_score, anomaly_active, total_detections_sent.
Returns current runtime config: device, anomaly_threshold, fusion_interval, target_fps, weights per detector, disabled_models, disabled_sa_modules, active_detectors.
Hot-updates runtime config without restart. All fields are optional. Changes take effect on the next micro-batch. Returns {"success": true, "changes": [...]}.

multipart/x-mixed-replace MJPEG stream — annotated frames from the completed micro-batch replay queue with fusion score bar, component scores, bounding boxes, and anomaly border. Open in browser or VLC. Replace cam-001 with the actual camera_id.
Returns a single annotated JPEG image/jpeg. Shows the latest processed frame with detection overlays. Replace cam-001 with the actual camera_id.

item.name: Edge Infrastructure (Direct)
item.description: Edge-tier services accessed directly (not through the gateway). These expose Prometheus metrics endpoints for monitoring.

request.description: Custom Prometheus exporter — exposes CPU, memory, disk, GPU, camera status, detection FPS, and detection latency metrics.
Video ingestion Prometheus metrics — camera_online, camera_fps, camera_frame_drops, camera_bitrate_kbps per camera.
Standard Prometheus node-exporter — host-level system metrics.
